import sys

parts = sys.stdin.read().split()
if len(parts) != 2:
    sys.exit("aynan ikkita son kutilgan")
a, b = map(int, parts)
if not (1 <= a <= 100 and 1 <= b <= 100):
    sys.exit(f"1 <= a, b <= 100 buzildi: a={a}, b={b}")
